SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.user_id AS reporterId, r.report_target_type AS reportTargetType, r.report_target_id AS reportTargetId, r.report_reason_type AS reportReasonType, r.report_regdate AS reportRegdate, r.report_status AS reportStatus, u_reporter.nickname AS reporterNickname, -- u_reported.nickname AS reportedUserNickname, ❌ 신고당한 유저 닉네임 조인 제거 CASE WHEN r.report_target_type = 'findboard' THEN fb.find_board_title WHEN r.report_target_type = 'question' THEN qb.question_board_title WHEN r.report_target_type = 'review' THEN rev.review_board_title WHEN r.report_target_type = 'hotdeal' THEN hd.hotdeal_title ELSE '알 수 없는 게시글' END AS postTitle FROM tblReports r INNER JOIN tblUser u_reporter ON r.user_id = u_reporter.user_id LEFT JOIN tblFindBoard fb ON r.report_target_type = 'findboard' AND r.report_target_id = fb.find_board_id LEFT JOIN tblQuestionBoard qb ON r.report_target_type = 'question' AND r.report_target_id = qb.question_board_id LEFT JOIN tblReviewBoard rev ON r.report_target_type = 'review' AND r.report_target_id = rev.review_post_id LEFT JOIN tblHotDealPost hd ON r.report_target_type = 'hotdeal' AND r.report_target_id = hd.hotdeal_id WHERE r.report_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.report_regdate DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
